settings.title: Settings
settings.generalGroupRecordingDesc: Choose how recording starts and stops, and set its time limit.
settings.generalGroupOutputDesc: Choose how recognized text is delivered and manage the result editor.
settings.generalGroupCapsuleDesc: Control whether recording status stays visible, on top, or hides when idle.
settings.generalGroupAudioDesc: Select a recording device and configure local speech preprocessing.
settings.generalGroupStartupDesc: Choose how PopSpeak starts after you sign in to Windows.
settings.hotkeyDesc: Click the key field below, then press a new key combination.
settings.hotkeyModeDesc: Hold the shortcut while speaking, or press once to start and again to stop.
settings.clickToConfirm: Click again to confirm, or press another combination
settings.outputModeDesc: Type text directly, paste through the clipboard, or review it in the result editor.
settings.editorOverlayHint: Show an always-on-top result editor. You can copy or edit text, and changes are saved back to history.
settings.editorAutoHideHint: Closes after the idle time expires; the countdown pauses when you start editing.
settings.editorManualCloseHint: With auto-close off, the editor stays visible until you click Done or Close.
settings.capsuleHint: Enabled and kept above normal windows by default. When always-on-top is disabled, other windows may cover it.
settings.sttSignInHint: The operator must enable this service separately. Local activation does not include cloud transcription credits.
settings.sttUpgradeHint: This cloud account is not authorized for the service. Availability, quota, and pricing are determined by the server.
settings.sttProActive: A cloud account is linked. Actual availability and remaining quota are determined by the server.
settings.llmSignInHint: The operator must enable this service separately. Local activation does not include cloud polishing credits.
settings.llmUpgradeHint: This cloud account is not authorized for the service. Availability, quota, and pricing are determined by the server.
settings.llmProActive: A cloud account is linked. Actual availability and remaining quota are determined by the server.
settings.storedLocally: Protected by Windows Credential Manager and never sent to PopSpeak servers.
settings.xiaomiPresetHint: Fills values from Xiaomi MiMo Audio Understanding docs (chat/completions). This differs from Whisper transcription protocol and may not work directly with the current STT pipeline.
settings.xiaomiPresetHintCompatible: Using Xiaomi MiMo provider (chat/completions protocol), which works with the current STT pipeline.
settings.selectedTextContextDesc: When enabled, the selected text in the foreground app will be captured via simulated Ctrl+C and sent to the LLM as context.
settings.aboutDescription: PopSpeak is a voice input assistant for Windows. It uses local offline recognition by default, keeping speech processing on your device for privacy and security. It supports CPU inference, dialects, multiple languages, and hotword management, with optional cloud recognition services such as Doubao.
settings.offlineUpdateNote: A network request is made only when you click this button; offline speech recognition never depends on it.
settings.maxRecordingDurationDesc: Stops recording at the limit to prevent accidental long-running sessions.
settings.microphoneDeviceDesc: Following the system default is recommended; select a dedicated microphone when needed.
settings.vad: Trim silence with 300 ms speech pre-roll
settings.audioCpuHint: All processing stays local on the CPU. No GPU or audio upload is used.
settings.startupBehaviorDesc: Launch with Windows and optionally start quietly in the system tray.

dictionary.title: Terms & Corrections
dictionary.correctionHint: Add names and specialist terms for supported recognition engines. Previous wrong forms and pronunciations are optional text correction rules.
dictionary.firstPrinciple: A hotword is a term you want the system to recognize correctly, such as a person's name, product, organization, or specialist term. Enter only the correct term.
dictionary.howItWorks: How the current engine uses hotwords
dictionary.decoderHotwordsHint: Hotwords are sent to the recognition engine when recording starts and can influence the raw transcript. You do not need to invent a wrong form. Hotwords are hints, not guaranteed matches.
dictionary.postprocessHotwordsHint: This engine cannot receive decoder hotwords. After recognition, the local vocabulary normalizes casing and separators. For a recurring incorrect word, add its wrong form or pronunciation under Advanced correction.
dictionary.addDecoderHotwordHint: Enter the correct term and it will guide decoding from the next recording. A previous wrong form is not required.
dictionary.addPostprocessHotwordHint: Enter the correct term for local normalization after recognition. Open Advanced correction only for a recurring wrong form.
dictionary.advancedCorrection: Advanced correction (optional wrong form or homophone)
dictionary.advancedCorrectionHint: Fill this in only when you know how the system commonly misrecognizes the term. It is separate from decoder hotwords.
dictionary.hotwordHint: A hotword alone can guide supported engines during recognition. An optional wrong form enables additional exact replacement after recognition; pronunciation supports text correction, not acoustic training.
dictionary.nativeHint: The decoder receives a vocabulary snapshot when recording starts. It influences the raw transcript, not just post-processing. These are hints, not guaranteed matches.
dictionary.unsupportedHint: The saved engine does not have recognition hotwords integrated. Choose Accurate Offline or Multilingual Offline. Your vocabulary is retained, but only configured text corrections apply in this mode.
dictionary.lifecycleHint: Additions, edits and deletions apply to the next recording without restarting. A recording already in progress keeps its original vocabulary.
dictionary.hotwordBudget: {{count}} terms are eligible for recognition. Selected in list order: up to 32 terms, 32 characters per term, and a total budget of 160 (ASCII costs 1, other characters 2, plus 2 per term). Excluded terms keep any configured text correction rules.
dictionary.outsideHotwordBudget: Not included in recognition hotwords (format or budget limit)
dictionary.saved: Vocabulary saved. It applies to the next recording according to engine capabilities.
dictionary.noEntries: No professional terms yet. Add one above or use Learn in the result editor.

scenes.howItWorks: One scene applies a useful group of settings
scenes.explanation: Choose a scene and PopSpeak configures output, text polishing, and any included hotwords. It does not replace your recognition model or existing vocabulary. Local scenes are available without an account or sign-in.
scenes.dailyDescription: Paste recognition results at the current cursor through the clipboard without AI rewriting, then restore the previous clipboard.
scenes.chatDescription: Lightly clean the transcript and type it into the current window, suitable for messages and short text.
scenes.meetingDescription: Review results in the editor, apply deep cleanup, and add common meeting vocabulary.
scenes.applied: Applied “{{name}}”. It takes effect from the next recording.
scenes.failedToApply: The scene was not fully applied. Check settings and try again.
scenes.activationRequired: This scene includes hotwords or text polishing and requires local activation.
scenes.safeRestoreHint: Restore daily defaults changes only output and polishing options. It never deletes saved personal hotwords or history.
